comment: Fluorinases mediate the conversion of S-adenosyl-l-methionine (SAM) and inorganic fluoride ions into 5′-fluoro-5′-deoxyadenosine (5′-FDA) and l-methionine. This represents the first step in the production of fluorinated metabolites

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 2 aligned GenPept ID with MIBiG ID.

reactions.description: Catalyzes the formation of a C-F bond by combining S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) and fluoride to generate 5'-fluoro-5'-deoxyadenosine (5'-FDA) and L-methionine. It can also use 2'-deoxyadenosine in place of adenosine as substrate
